changes: Decode strict-standard JSON regardless of file extension, then recursively scan all decoded keys and values.
Preserve all object key/value pairs during scan, so duplicate keys cannot hide overwritten known-ID values.
Report strict_json_keys_values_scanned per asset; parse failures and non-JSON text do not claim decoded coverage.
Reject non-standard NaN/Infinity JSON constants from strict-decoding coverage. Literal text/byte known-ID scan still applies.
correction: Independent review found escaped JSON known-ID bypass in UTF8 assets; prior no-match scanner lacked decoded JSON coverage. Original v1 audit retained, not retroactively passed.
limits: No arbitrary encoding/compression/semantic alias guarantee; independent full release review remains required.
No production or real-driver integration; only new module/test edited, historical evidence preserved.
